benchmark.name: BEIR NFCorpus
benchmark.metric_convention: BEIR/MTEB retrieval nDCG@10; percentage leaderboard values normalized to decimal for comparison

primary_target.label: Current public MTEB English Retrieval NFCorpus target
primary_target.source: MTEB Hugging Face leaderboard data table
primary_target.retrieval_type: embedding retrieval leaderboard entry; hosted/API model, not local open-weight
primary_target.comparison_rule: A local result must have nDCG@10 >= 0.4699 under matching NFCorpus test metric rules; prefer >= 0.4709 to avoid rounding ambiguity.

local_open_weight_reference.label: Best current open-weight MTEB NFCorpus reference observed in the live table
local_open_weight_reference.source: MTEB Hugging Face leaderboard data table
local_open_weight_reference.retrieval_type: embedding retrieval leaderboard entry; open-weight model

official_beir_reference.label: Official BEIR EvalAI NFCorpus comparator
official_beir_reference.note: The highest observed NFCorpus value on the official EvalAI table is 0.385, though the table is older than the current MTEB retrieval table.

selection_rationale: The active GOAL.md requires live target verification before implementation.
The official BEIR EvalAI table is the canonical BEIR challenge comparator, but the current MTEB retrieval table is newer and has a higher NFCorpus value.
The primary target is intentionally the stricter current public MTEB NFCorpus value, normalized from 46.99 percent to 0.4699.
The official BEIR EvalAI value and best open-weight MTEB value are retained as comparator gates, not as target-moving fallbacks.
known_caveats: MTEB table values are shown as percentages; local harness emits decimals.
The primary target comes from a hosted/API model entry, so a fully local/open-weight pipeline may need to beat a closed hosted comparator.
Only nDCG@10 is target-setting; Recall@100 remains a required secondary metric for local artifacts.
